title: Provide Guidance for Extending and Customizing the Project
description: Add sections to the document that guide developers on adding new pages, features, or UI components using shadcn/ui, and recommend best practices for maintainability.
details: Write step-by-step instructions for adding a new dashboard page, creating a new UI component, and extending Zod schemas. Include code snippets and references to official documentation. Highlight best practices for code organization, accessibility, and theming.
test_strategy: Test the clarity and accuracy of the instructions by following them in a sample scenario. Ensure best practices are clearly stated and actionable.

title: Review, Refine, and Link Documentation
description: Edit the TECHNICAL_OVERVIEW.md for clarity, completeness, and accuracy. Add a link to the new document in README.md.
details: Proofread the entire document, ensuring consistency in style and technical accuracy. Update README.md to reference the new technical overview. Confirm that all sections are complete and that the document is useful for both junior and senior developers. Address deployment and testing considerations as outlined in the PRD.
test_strategy: Peer review the documentation for clarity and completeness. Confirm that README.md correctly links to TECHNICAL_OVERVIEW.md. Validate that the document meets the goals stated in the enriched description and implementation guidance.

title: Draft Technical Overview Document Structure
description: Create the initial structure and outline for the TECHNICAL_OVERVIEW.md file, ensuring all required sections are represented.
details: Design a clear hierarchy for the TECHNICAL_OVERVIEW.md document. Include sections for: Project Purpose & Tech Stack, Directory Structure, Architectural Patterns, Key User Flows (e.g., authentication), shadcn/ui Component Usage, Extending the Project, Testing & Deployment Considerations, and Getting Started. Use Markdown headings and placeholders for content to be filled in subsequent tasks. Consider using a table of contents for easy navigation.
test_strategy: Review the outline to ensure all specified topics from the enriched description and implementation guidance are present and logically ordered. Validate that the structure is clear and comprehensive.

title: Document Project Architecture and File Structure
description: Populate the technical overview with detailed explanations of the project's architecture and directory structure.
details: Fill in the sections covering the high-level architecture (Next.js App Router, Server/Client Components, Provider Pattern, etc.) and provide a breakdown of the directory and file structure. Explain the purpose of each top-level directory and key files, referencing specific examples (e.g., app/layout.tsx, components/ui/). Use diagrams (e.g., Mermaid) and code snippets where appropriate.
test_strategy: Verify that all architectural patterns and directory explanations are accurate, clear, and illustrated with examples. Ensure diagrams render correctly in Markdown.

title: Explain Key User Flows and Core Functionalities
description: Describe major user flows (such as authentication and navigation) and explain how core functionalities are implemented and connected.
details: Detail the authentication flow, dashboard navigation, theming, and how the layout system works. Include step-by-step walkthroughs, code references, and diagrams to illustrate how components and routes interact. Address how to extend or modify these flows for new features.
test_strategy: Check that user flows are described in a way that a new developer can follow and understand. Validate that all core functionalities mentioned in the PRD are covered and explanations are technically correct.
